This plot is small, only about a quarter of my land, so I plant it with something other than my main cereal — I keep it for my household needs. I have some schooling and I know fertilizer helps, but the price at the cooperative is high, so I only put a little DAP at planting and save my cattle manure for this plot since it is close to the homestead. I cannot afford irrigation equipment, so I depend on the rains like my neighbors, and my wife and I do most of the work ourselves. Only at weeding and harvest time will I call two or three people from the village to help for a few days.
